subject: Upcoming Team Building Event - RSVP Required
body: Dear Team, We are excited to announce our upcoming team building event scheduled for next month. The event will include various team-building activities and a dinner reception. Please RSVP by the end of this week so we can finalize the arrangements. We look forward to having a great time together and strengthening our team bond. If you have any dietary restrictions or preferences, please let us know in your response. Thank you! Best regards, [Your Name]
